Author: Serpens66
Name: Spectator
Description: Spectator perspectives, live statistics and local AI testing tools.

Changes: The Lord Overview now shows enemy popularity, matching the value displayed above their campfires.
Sorting built-in columns uses the actual value even when a cell shows a question mark.
Mods can set visibility rules for their own columns and choose whether hidden values affect sorting. Requires APIShared 0.79.3.
The automatic gate button of Extra Features appears again in the test tools' gate panel and switches the selected AI gate. Requires APIShared 0.73.0.
Log failed AI troop placements with the owner, unit type, chosen task and available internal failure reason, including failures after spawning. These support messages are available in normal builds.

Placing troops into an AI's existing defense groups (castle defense, patrol, home moat, economy protection, intervention) now also works after loading a save and when placing several units at once; the AI gives the new troops their orders on its next turn. Placing several troops into a new harassment or siege group no longer fails after the first troop. Requires APIShared 0.56.1.
The task selection for new AI troops now explains in each entry what the AI uses that group for, for example what the siege reserve or the cover group does.

New AI troops now count as extra to the AI's planned army by default (clearer option name and explanation). The task selection is remembered per unit type; a unit type whose task does not fit shows No AI instead of an invalid selection.
Make the AI assignment box fit its contents and dock beside the build menu. Drag its title to move it for the current session, or return it to the build menu to dock again.
Explain AI tasks, additional troops and editor placement in clearer tooltips, and keep the selected task fully visible.
Respect an explicitly selected mod language after the game's startup cleanup.

Conflicts with other mods that change the same spot in the game's code are now detected: the affected feature stays off instead of overwriting the other mod's change, and the log names the conflict. Spots that a mod loaded later overwrites are reported in the log at each game start.
Fix a rare startup error that could turn off the map view and building placement used when building for other players until the game was restarted.
Fix the military AI assignment bar staying hidden when selecting test units through the normal troop buttons during a singleplayer game.
Use shared validation for building lookups; require APIShared 0.49.0. Gameplay rules and settings are unchanged.
Require APIShared 0.48.0 or newer for safe ally-panel and report patches.
Add Show while HUD hidden to the in-game statistics settings so an open scoreboard can stay visible when you hide the HUD.
Add a local option to show and move the game date while the HUD is hidden. The date position is saved.
If a game update changes the ally panel or the reports button, Spectator leaves that part unchanged. Other mods' changes to the same game methods keep working.
Require APIShared 0.47.0 or newer.
Keep spectator perspectives and report access pending through slow mission startup and paused save recovery; resume from current-mission PlayState events instead of giving up after 15 seconds.
Require APIShared 0.33.0 or newer.

Choose the military AI assignment and regular or additional recruitment accounting for newly placed units. No AI is the default; incompatible types, missing crews and unsupported current orders are rejected explicitly.
Save authored unit assignments in maps and saves. The map editor can declare tasks before an AI exists and optionally apply a validated preview to its current AI.
Integrate new members into the running group order without reissuing commands to existing members. Local placement mutations remain unavailable in real multiplayer.
Require APIShared 0.30.0 or newer.
First release in the Serps Mods pack. Spectator features previously included in Bugfixes and QoL now live in this mod; existing perspective and post-elimination settings are transferred once.
Switch the displayed player, reports and ally view through the portrait bar as a spectator or an eliminated player with host permission.
Open detailed match statistics and the Lord overview during play; the host can allow extra enemy statistics for active players.
Optionally control the viewed player as a spectator from the start of a singleplayer skirmish. Off by default; the selected player's AI remains active.

Use optional AI test tools for buildings, units, goods, gold, orders, powers and gates. Spectator tools and active-player singleplayer test mode are both off by default and unavailable in real multiplayer and the map editor.
Keep the camera in place when placing test buildings for an AI lord. Eliminated spectators see the build menu read-only unless an allowed singleplayer test placement is active.
Credit gold immediately or add goods as storage space becomes available; debit removes stored and incoming reserves down to zero. Rejected amounts show the reason.
Edit the amount only by clicking its field. Enter and Esc finish editing without sending a credit or debit and return keyboard control to the game; an empty field becomes zero.
Require APIShared 0.27.0 or newer.
